name: One way to explain what the records don't cover
objective: Compare the two research-first book runs (Note's P8-x9 English textbook; arb_upbit_1's P58-pm research then P59-d8 book) and build one standard route into the explain plugin and the workspace's explain route: research runs in its own findings-only phase, explain writes only from records and accepts a research-covered subject with no code, one request chains both, the explain checks stay, the result is always a real book, and a signed book's chapters are written in parallel.

review.note: round 1: F1 research first offered only when no phase covers the subject (P59-d8's covered-code-plus-basics case has no entry; an operator's research first is not honoured); F2 the critic's HEAD read of sibling chapters misses in a nested install
